canonical_rules: 1. price/reviews: canonical when values agree across files; a disagreement sets the canonical value to null and flags a conflict.
2. prime_fba: only file A carries it -> canonical from file A.
3. bsr/rank: only file B carries BSR and Rank -> canonical from file B.
4. title: file A is the 47-row primary reference; on disagreement the canonical title is file A's, flagged title_conflict for review.
5. capture timestamp: no timestamp column exists -> null, capture_time_status 'unknown' (reference only, not freshness proof).
